app.name: FitSense
app.tagline: Universal Fit Intelligence for Pakistani fashion

hero.title: Stop guessing your size
hero.subtitle: One profile. Perfect size recommendations across Khaadi, Sapphire, Breakout, Diners, Outfitters, and more.

problem.title: The sizing problem
problem.description: Medium at Khaadi is not the same as Medium at Sapphire. Every brand has different measurements, so you end up ordering multiple sizes, returning what doesn't fit, or hesitating at checkout.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step3: Get your exact size recommendation with a confidence score
howItWorks.description: We compare your measurements with each brand's real size chart — no averages, no guesswork.

retailers.title: For retailers
retailers.description: Reduce sizing-related returns and increase buyer confidence. FitSense gives your shoppers their perfect size before purchase.

onboarding.title: Profile Setup
onboarding.step1Subtitle: Choose how you'd like to view measurements and sizing
onboarding.step2Subtitle: We treat your body measurements as strictly confidential personal data.
onboarding.consentBullet1: We store your measurements to calculate product-specific recommendations.
onboarding.consentBullet2: Your personal measurements are NEVER sold or shared with retailers.
onboarding.consentBullet3: You can download a complete JSON copy or permanently delete your account anytime.
onboarding.consentCheckbox: I explicitly consent to FitSense storing my body measurements and fit preferences.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Enter your measurements or measure a favorite garment you already own.
onboarding.orGarment: Or measure a garment you already own
onboarding.garmentModalDesc: Lay a well-fitting top flat on a table and measure across the chest (armpit to armpit).
onboarding.estimateBadge: Estimated from garment. You can edit any value below.
onboarding.step4Subtitle: How do you prefer each clothing category to fit your body?

tips.chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping tape horizontal.
tips.waist: Measure around your natural waistline, where you bend side to side.
tips.hip: Measure around the widest part of your hips and seat.
tips.shoulder: Measure from the tip of one shoulder across your upper back to the other tip.
tips.sleeve: Measure from shoulder point down to your wrist bone.
tips.inseam: Measure along the inside of your leg from the crotch to your ankle.
tips.kameez_length: Measure from the shoulder collar seam straight down to your desired hemline.

profile.storeMeasurementsDesc: Keep your body measurements saved in your secure profile for instant size calculations across online fashion stores.

profile.consentWithdrawnSuccess: Measurement storage consent withdrawn. All stored measurements deleted.
profile.accountDeletedSuccess: Your account and personal data have been permanently deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.subtitle: Your body data belongs to you. Period.
privacy.legalNotice: Note: This privacy policy draft is pending formal legal counsel review.

sections.whatWeCollectBody: We collect only the measurements and category fit preferences you explicitly provide.
sections.howWeUseBody: Your measurements are strictly compared against garment size charts to calculate recommendations. We never sell, rent, or monetize your personal measurements.
sections.rightsBody: You have the right to inspect, download (data portability), and permanently wipe your account and measurements at any moment.

confirmModal.title: Permanently Delete Account?
confirmModal.text: This action cannot be undone. All your body measurements, saved sizes, and recommendations will be permanently removed from our databases.
